envelope.description: End a correlated turn's input in run()'s finally when its reader is abandoned

body.title: End a correlated turn's input in run()'s finally when its reader is abandoned
body.summary: In run()'s finally in vscode-plugin/src/chat/cli-adapter.ts, add the branch for a correlated turn (state.requestUuid defined) with no terminal event: call the endInput() seam once before the existing pipe-turn kill, shielded so a throwing seam cannot skip the rest of the cleanup. Nothing else changes: no early close, no change to the lifecycle, the panel or the observer.
acceptanceChecks: An abandoned correlated session-file turn ends its input once and is not killed
An abandoned correlated pipe turn ends its input and is still stopped with SIGTERM
A turn that reached its terminal event adds no second endInput call from the finally
A throwing endInput does not skip the pipe-turn kill or the pending-request cleanup
Codex and Vibe turns never call endInput
